items.note: Master's thesis: 407 undergraduates did a restaurant-concept ideation task under different GenAI conditions, but were regrouped by actual behavior (no AI, AI-generated, augmented, prompt engineering), so the analyzed groups are self-selected; abstract read through a WebFetch summary of the repository page; idea quality and originality outcomes per search notes.

Turkish pretest-posttest quasi-experiment with two third-grade classes (30 with ChatGPT-supported feedback on creative writing for six weeks, 30 without feedback); creative writing products scored with a rating scale; class-level assignment and the control got no feedback at all.

HICSS randomized experiment where groups solved complex problems with or without an AI collaborator (AI-deation system); participants' idea innovativeness was not significantly changed; sample size not in abstract; same authors as c823, check for sample overlap.

ICIS 2025 randomized 2x2 experiment (N=96) crossing idea-sharing structure with presence of a GLM AI peer in collaborative divergent thinking; exposure to AI ideas lowered participants' fluency and originality; may share a sample or system with c822.

Carleton HCI thesis: participants sketched websites with AI-generated inspiration, search-engine inspiration, or none; design performance and fixation measured; assignment and N not in abstract; likely overlaps with c825 (same author).

Nonprofessionals made wireframe prototypes with or without AI-generated sample designs; design quality, accuracy, time and user experience compared, moderated by visual imagery vividness; N not in abstract (search notes say 40, below the 50 threshold); related to thesis c824.

System paper (KidPrompt text-to-image tool for children) with a comparative study of 12 children on idea exploration and refinement; unclear whether the comparison is against a baseline tool or whether outputs are scored; very small N.

SSRN working paper comparing design ideation that starts with manual sketching versus AI-led image generation, with design quality and idea variance outcomes per search notes; abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, Europe PMC empty; SSRN 403), so design and N unconfirmed.

IEEE REW workshop paper: controlled experiment (N=60) on ChatGPT and undergraduates' creative thinking (fluency, originality, flexibility) plus a survey (N=100); ChatGPT raised fluency only; assignment method not stated.

CHI 2026 system paper (GraftMind, AI mediator feeding collective ideas into private workspaces) with a user study reporting better group ideation performance; comparison conditions, N and scoring not stated in the abstract.
